duration_protocol.research_question: Does food13 benefit from additional training along the same uninterrupted trajectory?
duration_protocol.primary_hypothesis: Mean greedy food score at100000 moves exceeds the paired40000-move snapshot across three independent training trajectories; improvement is not assumed.
duration_protocol.analysis: Three independent100k training trajectories.40k/60k/80k/100k snapshots within each trajectory are correlated repeated measurements; evaluation episodes are paired conditions, not independent training replications. Primary result100k minus40k; intermediate results descriptive, never used to choose the best checkpoint. Sample SD across training-seed means; no significance tests.
duration_protocol.snapshot_definition: Post-optimizer-update copies. Saving never truncates/resets an episode or changes replay, exploration, RNG, optimizer or target schedule. Train uninterrupted to100000 before evaluating snapshots.40000 snapshot is not an independent40000-budget run and creates no artificial boundary there.

diagnostic.interpretation: Same pooled next states from both algorithms and all three seeds. Signed estimator disagreement, not actual overestimation: no ground-truth returns measured. Pool is policy-dependent and nonuniform. Targets lag by one optimizer update at final checkpoints; small gaps can reflect recent synchronization and do not prove calibrated Q values.
